summary: Recursion's lead asset REC-4881 continues to build on its TUPELO trial data (53% polyp reduction at week 25 in FAP, a rare genetic cancer condition with no approved treatment). Cathie Wood's ARK Invest bought 260K shares, signaling continued institutional interest. The stock is trading up on 'a pivotal AI-driven drug discovery breakthrough' per recent coverage, though the FDA registrational study design update remains the defining binary catalyst, expected September-October 2026. Analyst average target ~$8 implies real upside from today's price, but note check #34's own validator flagged this exact report's scenario math for revision earlier — this refresh recomputes everything cleanly off today's live price.

catalysts.name: REC-4881 FDA Registrational Study Design Update
catalysts.description: FDA meeting to confirm registrational pathway for REC-4881 in FAP (Familial Adenomatous Polyposis). TUPELO trial: 53% polyp reduction at wk 25 — unprecedented efficacy for a rare disease with no approved treatment. Sep-Oct 2026 timeline unchanged from prior updates.

catalysts.name: Q2 2026 Earnings
catalysts.description: Aug 4, 2026. Key watch: REC-4881 TUPELO trial week 48 data update, cash runway update, any new partnerships or licensing deals from the AI drug-discovery platform.

catalysts.name: AI Platform Partnerships
catalysts.description: Recursion OS has existing partnerships with Roche, Bayer, and NVIDIA. ARK Invest's continued accumulation (260K shares recently) signals institutional confidence beyond just the REC-4881 story.

risks: Binary clinical/regulatory outcome — REC-4881 FDA pathway confirmation is all-upside if positive; a negative outcome or requested additional trials would likely trigger a -40% to -60% move
Severe cash burn — approximately $81M per quarter against $665M cash runway (through early 2028 as of last update, worth reconfirming at the Aug 4 print)
$300M ATM dilution facility remains in place — can dilute shareholders meaningfully if drawn on
No FAP regulatory precedent exists — FDA has never approved a chemopreventive agent for FAP specifically, meaning the pathway itself carries genuine novelty risk beyond just the trial data
AI drug discovery platform is still unproven at scale — REC-4881 remains the first major proof point; a stumble here would cast doubt on the broader platform thesis, not just this one asset

estimateDates.note: TUPELO wk 48 data update + cash runway + partnerships — key read on clinical momentum
FDA meeting confirms registrational trial design — binary outcome for FAP indication

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed at 3.50-3.75%; biotech valuations here are driven by clinical/regulatory data, not the rate cycle. RXRX is pre-revenue — rate moves don't directly affect pipeline value.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Core PCE at 3.4% YoY (May) is a secondary factor; biotech clinical trial costs are inflation-exposed but TUPELO trial costs are already locked in.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Small-cap biotech has shown real recent weakness alongside other high-beta groups — a genuinely risk-off macro tape into the dense Jul 27-Aug 1 FOMC week (which lands right around RXRX's own Aug 4 earnings) could compound any disappointment.
macroRisk.summary: Fed risk LOW on the fundamental thesis (clinical/regulatory-driven), but the Aug 4 earnings date sits right in the middle of the dense FOMC/Big-Tech/PCE week, adding macro-driven volatility on top of the underlying binary clinical risk.

entryStrategy.verdict: ค่าขนม — ARK actively buying, analyst avg $8 implies real upside. TUPELO 53% polyp reduction is a genuine medical breakthrough in an unmet need. Size small (1-3%) and treat as a binary option: FDA pathway confirmed = 2-3x; rejected = -50%+.

catalystSpot.preRunup: Biotech FDA feedback events typically see 20-40% pre-run in the 2-4 weeks before if trial data is strong. RXRX's ongoing ARK accumulation plus TUPELO 53% wk-25 data provide a strong foundation for continued pre-run into the Sep-Oct FDA meeting.

postWin.note: Biotech small-cap FDA pathway confirmations in rare disease: avg +60-100% on the day. FAP is a rare (1/8,000) disease with no approved treatment — orphan drug designation = fast-track potential. Examples: FOLD (FDA pathway confirm 2023: +54%), PTCT (rare disease pathway confirm 2024: +40%).

postLose.note: FDA rejection of a novel rare disease pathway in a small biotech = -40% to -60% crash. RXRX at $3.35 has limited absolute dollar downside but still a severe percentage hit in the worst case.

spotSizing.reason: Binary FDA outcome; no approved treatment precedent for FAP chemoprevention. Analyst upside is real but purely binary. ≤2-3% of portfolio maximum — ค่าขนม sizing.
